title: axum
notes: axum's router and JSON helper with MiniJinja templates, on the default multi-threaded Tokio runtime. Release build, no middleware.
details: axum's router, Path and State extractors and Json and Html responses; pages are MiniJinja templates (with inheritance and a price filter) parsed once at start and held in the router's state, as in axum's own templates-minijinja example, and escaped by MiniJinja. Askama, the engine most often paired with axum, was not used because it writes &, < and > as numeric references (& < >), which the page comparison does not treat as equal to & < >. /about is rendered from its template on each request: axum has no build-time prerendering. No middleware is added (axum adds none by default, so no compression). Built with cargo build --release at Cargo's default optimization settings and run as one process on Tokio's default multi-threaded runtime (one worker thread per core), so idle workers cost some CPU under a light load. Cargo cannot skip build scripts or procedural macros, so those of the locked crates run at build time, as for every Rust entry here.
